rows.what_the_ink_shows: After rotating the supplied upside-down typescript by 180 degrees, the header reads - 35 - and n°357. LEMME 3 concerns two composable measures and multiplication by a character; the following formula uses convolution. The next paragraph describes an action on L^p(E;gamma), and PROPOSITION 9/formula (14) contains convolution expressions weighted by chi^(1/q) and chi^(1/p) (crops/8_scan072_L743_number_and_convolution.jpg). The closing editorial paragraph explicitly mentions Bourbaki and convolution dans les L^p (crops/8_scan072_L743_bourbaki_note.jpg). The full scan has the handwritten sheet number 71. The quoted catalogue description of purity, base change, coefficient twists and modular weights, and its scan range, are absent from the image and page.tex.

The chi-weighted convolution formulas are visible; this page does not independently define chi as the modular function, so that precise identification is retained as the supplied correction's explanation rather than a newly established definition or proof.
